fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the Notification for the Primary & Middle School Teacher Post. The Applications for the MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Recruitment 2026 has Started from 21 August 2026, & Candidate can apply till 04 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB)

MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Recruitment 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 August 2026
  • Last Date : 18 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 18 September 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 20 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 12 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 1000/-
  • Portal Charge : Rs. 60/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

[adinserter block=”3″]

MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Notification 2026 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 January 2026
  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 40 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher 2026 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : N/A Posts

MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Only teachers working in primary and secondary schools are eligible to apply for this examination.
  • Read Official Notification For Eligibility and Qualification.

How To Apply : MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Online Form 2026

  • Candidates can apply through link https://esb.mp.gov.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the MPESB before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other  Notification Here – 
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।

MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Recruitment 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • CBT Exam
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination
